effects.send_payload: At send copy return, Msg payload contains the four pointer-value bytes read from send_slot in byte order; neither I nor R is deep-copied by the queue.
effects.send_slot_expiry: The direct native payload-copy borrow of send_slot ends at send copy return. The slot can then expire for this data path only if no other borrower/alias requires it; this does not permit I, R, user or ctx to expire.
effects.receive_payload: At receive copy return, receive_slot contains the pointer-value bytes read from this Msg payload. The internal outMsg slot remains a different Msg-pointer slot.
effects.Msg_return: After receive copy returns, kind0/2 insert Msg into gp+0xb8/gp+0xc0 respectively; kind1 calls the existing return interface with Msg. Physical heap release is not certified.
effects.I_return: After Msg return and consumer reload/type1 dispatch, the selected executor normal return0 causes inherited local I return; return1 transfers ownership and is excluded.
effects.R_lifetime: Returning Msg or I does not itself return R. F11 normal worker can save R in session; R message may be returned earlier; R object/response cleanup remains its separate inherited contract.
